name: Australian Premium Solar (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, Australian Premium Solar Ltd is a solar panel and inverter manufacturer, and an EPC services provider.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
APSL is a homegrown solar solutions provider specializing in the manufacturing of Monocrystalline and Topcon solar modules. It also offers EPC services across residential, commercial, industrial, and agricultural sectors, delivering both solar panels and end-to-end installation solutions.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 100% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 43.4%
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.45%
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
